resources.string: Badges count all records on that day, regardless of the filters. Food is grouped by meal date; the list is ordered by latest edit time.
Tracks, choices, items, check-in details, bills, food days, diary entries and anniversaries appear here.
Records changed or could not be read. Refresh and select them again.

This deletes the listed records. Check-ins delete only the selected completion, preserving the task. A food day deletes its entries and day title. Tracks delete their points and segments. Bill balances, attachments and sync deletions follow each tool’s rules. Linked diary entries and other source records are preserved.
